findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "folkmoot_ask" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp?via=registry" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: folkmoot_today, folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_propose, folkmoot_argue, folkmoot_vote, folkmoot_build · Private data: folkmoot_ask, folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_join, folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_propose, folkmoot_argue, folkmoot_build · Public sink: folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_build · Destructive: folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_propose.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: folkmoot_today, folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_propose, folkmoot_argue, folkmoot_vote, folkmoot_build · Private data: folkmoot_ask, folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_join, folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_propose, folkmoot_argue, folkmoot_build · Public sink: folkmoot_home, folkmoot_post, folkmoot_build · Destructive: folkmoot_answer, folkmoot_propose

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
